items.prompt: ____ her homework, she went out to play with her friends.
items.translation_tr: Ödevini bitirdikten sonra arkadaşlarıyla oynamak için dışarı çıktı.
items.hint: One action happened before the other. (Perfect Participle)
items.explain: We use 'Having + V3' (Perfect Participle) to show that one action was completed before the next one started.

items.prompt: The man ____ at the bus stop is my primary school teacher.
items.translation_tr: Otobüs durağında bekleyen adam ilkokul öğretmenim.
items.explain: A present participle (-ing) can replace a relative clause with an active meaning.

items.prompt: ____ by the news of his death, everyone started to cry.
items.translation_tr: Onun ölüm haberiyle şok olan herkes ağlamaya başladı.
items.hint: The people were shocked by something. (Passive meaning)
items.explain: A past participle (-ed) is used when the meaning is passive (Being shocked).

items.prompt: ____ the door, he realized he had left his keys on the table.
items.translation_tr: Kapıyı açarken anahtarlarını masada unuttuğunu fark etti.
items.hint: These two actions happened almost at the same time.
items.explain: We use the present participle (-ing) for actions that happen simultaneously or in quick succession.

items.prompt: ____ in the city for ten years, she knows all the shortcuts.
items.translation_tr: On yıldır şehirde yaşadığı için tüm kestirme yolları biliyor.
items.hint: The ten years of living happened before 'knowing'.
items.explain: Perfect participle emphasizes the duration or completion of the first action.

items.prompt: The books ____ by the professor are available in the library.
items.translation_tr: Profesör tarafından önerilen kitaplar kütüphanede mevcut.
items.explain: Past participles replace passive relative clauses (which were recommended).

items.prompt: ____ a teacher, I enjoy helping students solve problems.
items.translation_tr: Öğretmen olduğum için öğrencilerin sorun çözmesine yardım etmekten hoşlanıyorum.
items.explain: Participle clauses can express a reason (Because/Since).

items.prompt: ____ (not / know) what to do, I called my father for advice.
items.translation_tr: Ne yapacağımı bilmediğim için babamı arayıp tavsiye istedim.

items.prompt: ____ (see) the film before, I didn't want to watch it again.
items.translation_tr: Filmi daha önce izlediğim için tekrar izlemek istemedim.
items.explain: Since I had seen the film already (Perfect Participle).

items.prompt: The car ____ (park) outside belongs to my neighbor.
items.translation_tr: Dışarıda park etmiş olan araba komşuma ait.

items.explain: Present participle clause showing two actions at once.

items.translation_tr: Haber karşısında şoka girmiş halde beni aradı.
